rationale: Both candidates independently converge on the two strongest confirmed ground-truth bugs (the v2-first codec gate mis-parsing legacy v1 checkpoints, flagged High by hsliuustc0106; and the WER-fallback silently feeding raw/wrong-format PCM into the eval, flagged by linyueqian), giving both solid precision on their headline findings. Neither covers the cumulative/delta re-slice bug, the ceil/floor padding bug, or the 'make this generalizable' comment from ground truth, capping recall for both. Y edges ahead because its slot-leak-on-abort finding (#4) matches the ground-truth High comment's framing and root-cause class more directly (finish hook / id-space mismatch), and its report is organized into a clear Blocking/Should-fix/Minor/Tests hierarchy with concrete, prioritized fixes, slightly improving actionability over X's denser, repetitive evidence-block format.
